title: A 50-Year-Old Frog Mystery Points to a Fungus
paragraphs: Many frogs lived in a forest in Brazil. In the 1970s and 1980s, many of them disappeared. People did not know why.
Scientists looked at old frogs from a museum. The frogs were kept in jars. The scientists tested them for a sick-making fungus.
They found the fungus only in frogs from after 1979. Today, many of the frogs are back. The scientists say this is good news.
